notes: Tuition details: the university page says only 'Semesterbeitrag: 352 €'; it does not state a tuition fee amount for this programme or for non-EU students. DAAD says 'Tuition fees per semester None'. No document list was found on the programme pages, so the documents fact was left out. Application channel: the DAAD page names both uni-assist and the website, but the university's own application page directs foreign-diploma applicants with an unrecognised foreign qualification to uni-assist; the German name 'Uni-Assist' is used and no preliminary review (VPD) is mentioned.
